in_arabic.name: فهم
in_arabic.meaning: فهم شديد و درك عميق للمعاني و الأمور
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فهم مشتق من الفهم و هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الفهم العميق و الإدراك الحاد للمعاني و الأمور، و يدل على الشخص الذي يتميز بالذكاء و الفطنة و القدرة على فهم الأمور بسهولة و سرعة.

in_urdu.name: فہم
in_urdu.long_meaning: فہم نام کا مطلب ہے گہرا سمجھنا، ذہانت، فطانت، عقلمند۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'فهم' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو گہری سمجھ و فہم اور ذہانت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फहमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: फहमी नाम का अर्थ है गहरा समझना, बुद्धिमत्ता, चतुराई। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'فهم' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है समझना, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो गहरी समझ और बुद्धिमत्ता की प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: پوهه
in_pashto.long_meaning: پوهه د دې نوم مطلب دی ژور پوهه، ذہانت، فطانت. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'فهم' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د پوهې او فہم معنی ورکوي، او دا د هغو نومونو څخه يو دی چې د پوهې او ذہانت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Faheem
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faheem is derived from the Arabic root 'فهم' (F-H-M), which means to understand or comprehend. It signifies someone with deep insight, intelligence, and the ability to grasp complex concepts quickly. In Islamic tradition, the name Faheem reflects the qualities of wisdom and discernment.

data.cultural_impact: Naming a child Faheem is a declaration of pride in his/her intellectual abilities and potential. The name signifies a deep-rooted respect for the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, which is deeply ingrained in the Islamic culture. It is a reminder that intelligence and knowledge are highly valued in Muslim societies.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Faheem also holds great spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is believed that knowledge and wisdom are essential for a person to live a righteous and fulfilling life. By giving a child this name, parents are expressing their hope that their child will grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable person, who uses his intelligence to make wise choices in life and serve as a role model for others. It is also seen as a blessing, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Seek knowledge even if it is in China." (Bukhari and Muslim). Thus, the name Faheem represents more than just intelligence or knowledge, it is a symbol of curioisity, determination, and a lifelong quest for knowledge in both the material and spiritual worlds.
